scripts.format: npm run format -w packages/admin && npm run format -w packages/pwa && cd packages/backend && . .venv/bin/activate && black app tests && isort app tests
scripts.lint: npm run lint -w packages/admin && npm run lint -w packages/pwa && cd packages/backend && . .venv/bin/activate && flake8 app tests
scripts.typecheck: npm run typecheck -w packages/admin && npm run typecheck -w packages/pwa && cd packages/backend && . .venv/bin/activate && mypy app tests
scripts.test: npm run test -w packages/admin && npm run test -w packages/pwa && cd packages/backend && . .venv/bin/activate && pytest
scripts.check: npm run lint && npm run typecheck && npm run test
